attchmntText: UNITEDTEA: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication concerning declaration of unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
sm_name: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited
voiceSummary: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited has published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 in Business Line and Dinamani on 11th November 2026. Total income from operations was Rs. 2,276.37 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 4,258.97 lakhs for the half year. Net profit after tax stood at Rs. 358.31 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 995.82 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs. 7.19 for the quarter and Rs. 19.93 for the half year. The company has no subsidiaries or joint ventures as of 30th September 2026.

attchmntText: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
sm_name: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited
voiceSummary: The United Nilgiri Tea Estates Company Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 10th November 2026. Net profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 358.31 Lakhs, compared to Rs. 493.57 Lakhs for the same period in 2025. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, net profit stood at Rs. 995.82 Lakhs against Rs. 1,295.70 Lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share for the quarter were Rs. 7.17, down from Rs. 9.88 in 2025. Half year earnings per share were Rs. 19.93, compared to Rs. 25.93 in 2025. Total income for the quarter was Rs. 2,456.21 Lakhs. The results include segment-wise data for Plantation and Property segments. Statutory auditors K. S. Aiyar & Co. conducted a limited review of these results.
